description: This file defines the SugarCachesMash class, which extends SugarCacheAbstract to provide caching functionality using filesystem-based external cache storage in a SuiteCRM environment. It manages cache entries, performing operations such as setting, retrieving, and clearing cache items via external functions that interact with the filesystem.

classes.name: SugarCachesMash
classes.description: A cache implementation that extends SugarCacheAbstract, providing filesystem-based cache storage for SuiteCRM, with methods to determine cache backend usage and handle external cache operations.

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Determines if external caching backend should be used based on function availability and configuration.

methods.name: _setExternal
methods.description: Stores a cache value externally into the filesystem.

methods.name: _getExternal
methods.description: Retrieves a cache value from the external filesystem cache.

methods.name: _clearExternal
methods.description: Removes a cache entry from the external filesystem cache.

methods.name: _resetExternal
methods.description: Clears all cache entries in the external filesystem cache directory.
